meta.title: Fantasy Concept Constellations
meta.visualContract: Every graph node is a normalized being/race/entity or class/vocation archetype. Validated characters and source terms are evidence, never nodes.

domains.label: Beings & Peoples
domains.description: Peoples, ancestries, spirits, monsters, divinities, undead, constructs, and other kinds of being.

domains.label: Classes & Vocations
domains.description: Martial, magical, religious, social, specialist, craft, and progression roles.

nodes.label: Mortal and Natural Peoples

nodes.functions: Organizes source-specific peoples and creatures by the kind of being they are.
